propositions: Compaction was removed from close path to fix P0 lock contention, leaving event logs with no automatic trigger in environments without CI or local cron
compact-all's selection logic picks only snapshot-less tickets on first run, making it a one-time backfill that cannot re-fold tickets grown after their initial fold

The system requires two independent compaction triggers that both avoid lock-holding during LLM calls and writer waits: a scheduled sweep where CI exists and an operation-linked fallback for deployments with no CI
Stand-aside detection during high contention can incorrectly stamp the sweep clock, suppressing recurrence detection and silently stopping compaction while appearing healthy
Authorship ledger building via per-ticket git log walks is O(events*history) inside the store write lock, causing multi-hour lock holds during store-wide sweeps on large repositories
